crop_preview.semantics: Simulation of the current 58%-height wall image box using object-fit cover and the shared upper-face focus position.

notes: The selected Universal Pictures still visibly depicts Lon Chaney's Phantom in the 1925 production, with the defining skull-like face, dark eye sockets, teeth, costume and hand pose all legible.
The exact Wikimedia Commons file page captions the subject as Lon Chaney as the Phantom and describes it as a film still of Chaney characterized as the Phantom.
The Commons source records Universal Pictures, publication in 1925 and public-domain status in the United States.
The exact 1246x1000 wall-crop simulation keeps the complete Phantom face, upper costume, crossed arms and extended hand; no defining evidence is cropped away.
The candidate is not a poster, advertisement, unrelated cast member, unmasked performer portrait or ambiguous group image.
